name: Coronoid Systems Are Never Partial Cubes
scope: Finite coronoid systems in their hexagonal-lattice embedding.
statement: The class of coronoid systems is disjoint from the class of partial cubes: no coronoid system admits an isometric hypercube embedding.
proof: Every coronoid has an edge for which one of the two associated semicubes is not convex. Convexity of both semicubes is necessary for the Djokovi{\'c}--Winkler relation to define hypercube coordinates, so the graph cannot be a partial cube.
